title: Reuse inherited and external API documentation
goal: Reuse shared F# API summaries through inherited or external XML documentation.

selectionNotes: Enable XML output; include expands at build time while inheritdoc remains a tag.

prerequisites: Use an F# net11.0 executable or library, .NET 11 SDK, FSharp.Core 11 and LangVersion=11.0.
Set GenerateDocumentationFile=true and provide ApiDocs.xml at build time.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Use the .NET 11 SDK and its F# compiler for the declared target.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: This verified edition targets net11.0; the .NET 10 sample is a comparison, not an older-target catalogue route.

language.name: F#
language.reason: Compiled in stable F# 11 language mode.

constraints: The compiler leaves inheritdoc unexpanded. Do not promise copied text or verify IDE tooltips merely from the emitted file.
The include file/path must select the intended nodes at compilation. The sample checks emitted content; no IDE, FCS symbol-tooltip or documentation-site rendering check is claimed.

packages.name: FSharp.Core
packages.reason: FSharp.Core 11 is the library dependency for this edition; the exact compiled RC2 version is recorded separately in evidence.

evidence.scope: Actual FSharpApi compilation and managed execution including documentation assertions; separate compiler/external-consumer probes in eng/Test-FSharpBoundaries.ps1. No mocks, cross-compilation, native/AOT deployment or GA execution claimed.
